name: session-band
description: Clawd above the prompt with your session at a glance. Two looks: tide (the default) puts him on a little beach where the tide rises as context fills; hearth sets him beside three calm lines. Switch with /band or in /config. /band still keeps either look calm, and /band lively brings the motion back. On the terminal it steps aside while a / or @ menu is up, and the Band size row in /config keeps it to one row. Works in the terminal and the desktop Code tab. Claude Code only.

look.title: Band look
look.description: tide: Clawd on a little beach, where the tide rises as your context fills. hearth: Clawd beside three calm lines. /band tide and /band hearth switch it too, and /band still keeps either look calm.

warnAt.title: Warn at
warnAt.description: Context fill, in percent, where the band nudges toward /compact (high tide on the beach; an orange percent and a sweating Clawd by the hearth), with a toast each time the context crosses it.

size.title: Band size
size.description: On the terminal: full draws Clawd on three rows beside his words; compact keeps the band to one row (his head, what is happening, and the context). Either way, in the fullscreen layout it gives up its rows while a / or @ menu is up, and keeps to one row whenever the prompt leaves it less room.
